data.name: Jaishika
data.gender_notes: Jaishika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jaishika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ja’ meaning victory and ‘shikha’ meaning knowledge or learning. This name signifies the triumph of knowledge and wisdom over ignorance and darkness. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu tradition and symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and enlightenment. The name Jaishika carries the meaning “Victory over ignorance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaishika usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over ignorance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace knowledge and wisdom to conquer ignorance and darkness.
data.etymology: Jaishika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory over ignorance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaishika total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
